text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's right before the race, and when I
walk into the
waiting room...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Phew! There, I'm done warming up! ☆ I
nailed my
ceremonial sumo stomp, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I am! I have to make up for my last race
being so
unmiraculous and non-buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You'd better get ready too! You've
gotta prepare
to have a blast at my
performance, and to smile
until your
face hurts!
